entries.text: 我可以告诉你：Overseer-所长。
entries.source_text: 我可以告诉你：Overseer-所长。

entries.text: You! Stop right there and face the law!
entries.source_text: You! Stop right there and face the law!

entries.text: 你！住手，你敢无视法律！
entries.source_text: 你！住手，你敢无视法律！

entries.text: Thank you for returning the water-chip. It's really# going to help morale, and keep people from breaking vault law.
entries.source_text:
Thank you for returning the water-chip. It's really
# going to help morale, and keep people from breaking vault law.

entries.text: 多谢你归还净水芯片。它真的能提升士气，还大大降低了避难所的犯罪率。
entries.source_text: 多谢你归还净水芯片。它真的能提升士气，还大大降低了避难所的犯罪率。

entries.text: Good to see you again. Is there anything that I can do for you?
entries.source_text: Good to see you again. Is there anything that I can do for you?

entries.text: 很高兴再见到你。我能为你做些什么？
entries.source_text: 很高兴再见到你。我能为你做些什么？

entries.text: What do you do?
entries.source_text: What do you do?

entries.text: 你做什么呢？
entries.source_text: 你做什么呢？

entries.text: Yeah, I need some weapons.
entries.source_text: Yeah, I need some weapons.

entries.text: 是的，我需要些武器。
entries.source_text: 是的，我需要些武器。

entries.text: Why would there be a locked door in the Vault?
entries.source_text: Why would there be a locked door in the Vault?

entries.text: 为什么避难所会有一扇锁住的门？
entries.source_text: 为什么避难所会有一扇锁住的门？

entries.text: Glop!
entries.source_text: Glop!

entries.text: 嗝咯！
entries.source_text: 嗝咯！

entries.text: Hmmm. I think you should be somewhere else besides here. Have a nice day.
entries.source_text: Hmmm. I think you should be somewhere else besides here. Have a nice day.

entries.text: 嗯。我认为你最好待在别的地方而不是这儿。走好。
entries.source_text: 嗯。我认为你最好待在别的地方而不是这儿。走好。

entries.text: I'm in charge of Vault security and law enforcement.# You might not know it, but the Vault wouldn't run as well if it wasn't for me.
entries.source_text:
I'm in charge of Vault security and law enforcement.
# You might not know it, but the Vault wouldn't run as well if it wasn't for me.

entries.text: 我主管避难所的安全和执法。你可能不知道我, 但是如果没有我，避难所不可能运行得这么好。
entries.source_text: 我主管避难所的安全和执法。你可能不知道我, 但是如果没有我，避难所不可能运行得这么好。

entries.text: Hmm. Neat. Thanks.
entries.source_text: Hmm. Neat. Thanks.

entries.text: 恩，非常好。谢谢。
entries.source_text: 恩，非常好。谢谢。

entries.text: Sounds important.
entries.source_text: Sounds important.

entries.text: 听起来挺重要。
entries.source_text: 听起来挺重要。

entries.text: It is. Without proper adherence to the laws, the Vault# would soon be a lawless place, with no direction. That would jeopardize# the safety of us all.
entries.source_text:
It is. Without proper adherence to the laws, the Vault
# would soon be a lawless place, with no direction. That would jeopardize
# the safety of us all.

entries.text: 的确如此。如果法律得不到维护，避难所很快就会无法无天。那会危害你我和所有人的安全。
entries.source_text: 的确如此。如果法律得不到维护，避难所很快就会无法无天。那会危害你我和所有人的安全。

entries.text: Now that I've been outside, are there any laws that# apply specifically to me?
entries.source_text:
Now that I've been outside, are there any laws that
# apply specifically to me?

entries.text: 我现在在外面，有什么特别的法律管我？
entries.source_text: 我现在在外面，有什么特别的法律管我？

entries.text: I've seen some places on the outside world that suffer# because they have no laws.
entries.source_text:
I've seen some places on the outside world that suffer
# because they have no laws.

entries.text: 我在外面的很多地方看到，因为没有法律而动荡不安。
entries.source_text: 我在外面的很多地方看到，因为没有法律而动荡不安。

entries.text: Well, even if weapons are required on the outside world,# don't display them in a threatening manner in here.# Other than that, I can't think of anything in particular.
entries.source_text:
Well, even if weapons are required on the outside world,
# don't display them in a threatening manner in here.
# Other than that, I can't think of anything in particular.

entries.text: 呃，虽说出门在外带武器是必需的，但也不要在这里拿出来恐吓人。至于其他，我还想不出什么特别的。
entries.source_text: 呃，虽说出门在外带武器是必需的，但也不要在这里拿出来恐吓人。至于其他，我还想不出什么特别的。

entries.text: Thanks.
entries.source_text: Thanks.

entries.text: 谢谢。
entries.source_text: 谢谢。

entries.text: You see, I knew that would happen. People obeying law# is the only thing that has saved the Vault from misery# and destruction. Keep up the good work.
entries.source_text:
You see, I knew that would happen. People obeying law
# is the only thing that has saved the Vault from misery
# and destruction. Keep up the good work.

entries.text: 你瞧，我就知道会是那样。遵纪守法是唯一让避难所免受灾难和痛苦的方法。好好干吧。
entries.source_text: 你瞧，我就知道会是那样。遵纪守法是唯一让避难所免受灾难和痛苦的方法。好好干吧。

entries.text: The Overseer has not authorized me to open the armory and# get you more weapons. I'm sorry, but I can't help you.
entries.source_text:
The Overseer has not authorized me to open the armory and
# get you more weapons. I'm sorry, but I can't help you.

entries.text: 所长没授权，所以我不能打开军械库给你更多武器。我很抱歉，我帮不了你。
entries.source_text: 所长没授权，所以我不能打开军械库给你更多武器。我很抱歉，我帮不了你。

entries.text: Please! I really need them!
entries.source_text: Please! I really need them!

entries.text: 求你了！我真的需要它们！
entries.source_text: 求你了！我真的需要它们！

entries.text: Ok. Thanks, anyways.
entries.source_text: Ok. Thanks, anyways.

entries.text: 好吧。不管怎样还是谢谢。
entries.source_text: 好吧。不管怎样还是谢谢。

entries.text: No. I can't do it.
entries.source_text: No. I can't do it.

entries.text: 不。我不能那样做。
entries.source_text: 不。我不能那样做。

entries.text: Have a nice day.
entries.source_text: Have a nice day.

entries.text: 祝你愉快。
entries.source_text: 祝你愉快。

entries.text: To keep the weapons away from those who don't have# access to them.
entries.source_text:
To keep the weapons away from those who don't have
# access to them.

entries.text: 确保没有武器使用权的人接触不到它们。
entries.source_text: 确保没有武器使用权的人接触不到它们。

entries.text: Who has access?
entries.source_text: Who has access?

entries.text: 谁有使用权？
entries.source_text: 谁有使用权？

entries.text: That doesn't seem very fair.
entries.source_text: That doesn't seem very fair.

entries.text: 似乎不太公平。
entries.source_text: 似乎不太公平。

entries.text: Life isn't fair, sometimes. But our law is. Have# a nice day.
entries.source_text:
Life isn't fair, sometimes. But our law is. Have
# a nice day.

entries.text: 有时候，生活就是不公平的。但我们的法律很公平。祝你愉快。
entries.source_text: 有时候，生活就是不公平的。但我们的法律很公平。祝你愉快。

entries.text: The Overseer, myself and my security team. That's it.
entries.source_text: The Overseer, myself and my security team. That's it.

entries.text: 所长，我自己以及我的执法小队。就这些。
entries.source_text: 所长，我自己以及我的执法小队。就这些。

entries.text: It sounds like only people with need have access.
entries.source_text: It sounds like only people with need have access.

entries.text: 听起来像是只有需要它的人才有使用权。
entries.source_text: 听起来像是只有需要它的人才有使用权。

entries.text: That's really a small list.
entries.source_text: That's really a small list.

entries.text: 就这么些人，真少。
entries.source_text: 就这么些人，真少。

entries.text: Yes, it is. I have to get back to work.
entries.source_text: Yes, it is. I have to get back to work.

entries.text: 是的，我必须回去工作了。
entries.source_text: 是的，我必须回去工作了。

entries.text: Yes, only people with need can get in.
entries.source_text: Yes, only people with need can get in.

entries.text: 是的，只有有需求的人才能进入。
entries.source_text: 是的，只有有需求的人才能进入。

entries.text: Well, I have need. Please open the door.
entries.source_text: Well, I have need. Please open the door.

entries.text: 好，我有需要。请打开门。
entries.source_text: 好，我有需要。请打开门。

entries.text: I'm sorry, it's a good argument, but I can't let you in.
entries.source_text: I'm sorry, it's a good argument, but I can't let you in.

entries.text: 抱歉，这理由不错，但我不能让你进入。
entries.source_text: 抱歉，这理由不错，但我不能让你进入。

entries.text: Hmm. Now that you mention it, it sounds like you do. Here,# let me get the door for you.
entries.source_text:
Hmm. Now that you mention it, it sounds like you do. Here,
# let me get the door for you.

entries.text: 唔。你这么一说，听起来的确需要。来，让我给你开门。
entries.source_text: 唔。你这么一说，听起来的确需要。来，让我给你开门。

entries.text: What can I do for you,
entries.source_text: What can I do for you,

entries.text: 我能为你做什么，
entries.source_text: 我能为你做什么，

entries.text: I need more weapons.
entries.source_text: I need more weapons.

entries.text: 我需要更多武器。
entries.source_text: 我需要更多武器。

entries.text: You feeling ok?
entries.source_text: You feeling ok?

entries.text: 你感觉还好吗?
entries.source_text: 你感觉还好吗?

entries.text: Huh-huh.
entries.source_text: Huh-huh.

entries.text: 咳-咳。
entries.source_text: 咳-咳。

entries.text: Great. Your intelligence staggers me. I can't possibly# think anymore.
entries.source_text:
Great. Your intelligence staggers me. I can't possibly
# think anymore.

entries.text: 你牛啊，都把我说晕了。我的脑子几乎不能再转了。
entries.source_text: 你牛啊，都把我说晕了。我的脑子几乎不能再转了。

entries.text: Sorry, you've gotten all we can spare. Good day.
entries.source_text: Sorry, you've gotten all we can spare. Good day.

entries.text: 对不起，你已经拿了我们能给出的全部。走好。
entries.source_text: 对不起，你已经拿了我们能给出的全部。走好。

entries.text: I don't like your kind. Rabble-rousers. You should be ashamed.
entries.source_text: I don't like your kind. Rabble-rousers. You should be ashamed.

entries.text: 我不喜欢你这种蛊惑民心的人。你该感到羞耻。
entries.source_text: 我不喜欢你这种蛊惑民心的人。你该感到羞耻。

entries.text: Yeah, well, same to you, muttonhead.
entries.source_text: Yeah, well, same to you, muttonhead.

entries.text: 是啊，没错，和你一样，猪头。
entries.source_text: 是啊，没错，和你一样，猪头。

entries.text: Don't you think you're being a little harsh?
entries.source_text: Don't you think you're being a little harsh?

entries.text: 你不觉得你有些太苛刻了吗？
entries.source_text: 你不觉得你有些太苛刻了吗？

entries.text: Watch your language, or I'll bring you in for failure# to respect a law enforcement officer.
entries.source_text:
Watch your language, or I'll bring you in for failure
# to respect a law enforcement officer.

entries.text: 嘴巴放干净些，否则我就以不尊重执法官的罪名把你抓起来。
entries.source_text: 嘴巴放干净些，否则我就以不尊重执法官的罪名把你抓起来。

entries.text: Yeah, right. See you around.
entries.source_text: Yeah, right. See you around.

entries.text: 哦，是呀。回见了您呐。
entries.source_text: 哦，是呀。回见了您呐。

entries.text: That's it. I'm fed up with you rousting me.
entries.source_text: That's it. I'm fed up with you rousting me.

entries.text: 到此为止。我受够了你的挑衅。
entries.source_text: 到此为止。我受够了你的挑衅。

entries.text: Hmm. Possibly. It should be my job to be impartial,# but I might have stepped over the line this time.# I'll try and do better in the future.
entries.source_text:
Hmm. Possibly. It should be my job to be impartial,
# but I might have stepped over the line this time.
# I'll try and do better in the future.

entries.text: 唔。可能。我的工作本是捍卫公正，但这次我也许有点过分了。将来我会努力做好的。
entries.source_text: 唔。可能。我的工作本是捍卫公正，但这次我也许有点过分了。将来我会努力做好的。

entries.text: Hmm. No. Probably not harsh enough.
entries.source_text: Hmm. No. Probably not harsh enough.

entries.text: 唔。不。我看可能是不够苛刻。
entries.source_text: 唔。不。我看可能是不够苛刻。

entries.text: Good luck. I hope you can do the job.
entries.source_text: Good luck. I hope you can do the job.

entries.text: 好运。我希望你能做到。
entries.source_text: 好运。我希望你能做到。

entries.text: You'd better not let me down.
entries.source_text: You'd better not let me down.

entries.text: 你最好别让我失望。
entries.source_text: 你最好别让我失望。

entries.text: Put your weapon away, right now.
entries.source_text: Put your weapon away, right now.

entries.text: 立即把武器放下。
entries.source_text: 立即把武器放下。

entries.text: What do you think you are doing with that in here?
entries.source_text: What do you think you are doing with that in here?

entries.text: 你带着那东西在这里想做什么？
entries.source_text: 你带着那东西在这里想做什么？

entries.text: Just practicing my aim.
entries.source_text: Just practicing my aim.

entries.text: 只不过试试我的准星。
entries.source_text: 只不过试试我的准星。

entries.text: Nothing, sorry. Didn't mean to have it drawn.
entries.source_text: Nothing, sorry. Didn't mean to have it drawn.

entries.text: 没什么，抱歉。我不是故意要把它拿出来的。
entries.source_text: 没什么，抱歉。我不是故意要把它拿出来的。

entries.text: Hung.
entries.source_text: Hung.

entries.text: 哼。
entries.source_text: 哼。

entries.text: Be careful what you call me. And don't draw a weapon# inside. This is the Vault for god's sake.
entries.source_text:
Be careful what you call me. And don't draw a weapon
# inside. This is the Vault for god's sake.

entries.text: 注意你对我的称谓。也不要在室内拿出武器。看在上帝的份上这可是个避难所。
entries.source_text: 注意你对我的称谓。也不要在室内拿出武器。看在上帝的份上这可是个避难所。

entries.text: You'd better not be practicing it in here. Me and you# will have a serious problem if you do it again.
entries.source_text:
You'd better not be practicing it in here. Me and you
# will have a serious problem if you do it again.

entries.text: 你最好别在这弄。下回你再这么做的话，你我之间就有大麻烦了。
entries.source_text: 你最好别在这弄。下回你再这么做的话，你我之间就有大麻烦了。

entries.text: I knew that outside life would get you into trouble.
entries.source_text: I knew that outside life would get you into trouble.

entries.text: 我就知道野外生活会给你惹上麻烦。
entries.source_text: 我就知道野外生活会给你惹上麻烦。

entries.text: Halt! You're not permitted in there!
entries.source_text: Halt! You're not permitted in there!

entries.text: 站住！你没有进入那里的许可！
entries.source_text: 站住！你没有进入那里的许可！

entries.text: Overseer
entries.source_text: Overseer

entries.text: He is the supreme authority of the Vault. The Vault answers to his# decisions.
entries.source_text:
He is the supreme authority of the Vault. The Vault answers to his
# decisions.

entries.text: 他是避难所的最高权威，决定着避难所的未来。
entries.source_text: 他是避难所的最高权威，决定着避难所的未来。
